label: FGFR2::AHCYL1

sections.text: FGFR2 encodes a fibroblast growth factor receptor tyrosine kinase.
AHCYL1 encodes IRBIT, a regulator of inositol-trisphosphate receptor signaling and membrane transport.

The fusion preserves the FGFR2 kinase region while altering its carboxy-terminal regulatory architecture; partner-mediated self-association can sustain FGFR signaling. FGFR2::AHCYL1 was detected in intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma.
Futibatinib is US-approved for adults with previously treated, unresectable locally advanced or metastatic intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma harboring an FGFR2 fusion or rearrangement.
